professionalSummary: Credit Risk Analyst with experience across a retail consumer credit and Credit Optimisation environment. Experience across retail credit portfolio forecasting, IFRS9 monitoring, PD calibration, Expected Credit Loss (ECL) environments, scorecard development, collections analytics, and bureau-data-driven modelling.

Exposure to high-volume retail account customer environments involving closed-loop retail credit facilities linked to in-store and online retail purchases. Experience working with finance-aligned portfolio forecasting models used for budgeting and long-term retail credit projections.

Involved in development, monitoring, optimisation, recalibration, and automation of retail credit risk models. Experience working with bureau data, repayment capacity estimation models, distressed debt models, collections scorecards, and customer behavioural analytics.
Exposure to originations optimisation and credit top-up response modelling within a retail credit environment. Experience mentoring junior analysts and supporting model ownership responsibilities.
Technical exposure includes SAS, SQL, Python, automated scoring processes, and analytical reporting environments.
